<?php

function salam($nama) {
    return "Halo, " . $nama . "!";
}

echo salam("Budi");

function hitung($a, $b, $operasi = "tambah") {
    return match($operasi) {
        "tambah" => $a + $b,
        "kurang" => $a - $b,
        "kali" => $a * $b,
        default => 0,
    };
}

echo hitung(10, 5) . "\n";
echo hitung(10, 5, "kurang") . "\n";

$fn = fn($x) => $x * 2;
echo $fn(7);
